opinions.text: C. A. 5th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 397 U. S. 1074.] Motion of respondents for leave to proceed in forma pauperis granted. Motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument as amicus curiae in support of petitioners granted and 30 minutes allotted for that purpose. Respondents allotted 30 additional minutes for oral argument.
